meta.title: Move off EventON with Beacon Events
meta.description: A small taproom site on EventON Lite (weekly trivia and live music, a first-Saturday run club, a release party, a market, a page with EventON's list shortcode) with Beacon Events installed next to it: import, look at the events at /beacon-events/ while visitors still see EventON, then switch EventON off.
meta.author: inmanjeffrey89-cell

steps.code:
<?php
// Seeds a small EventON Lite site for the "try the move off EventON" Playground (blueprints/eventon-move.json).
// Runs after EventON Lite is activated. Stored the way EventON Lite keeps events (tests/eventon-seed.php, checked against
// 2.5.9 and a real site): ajde_events posts, "virtual" unix times (the wall clock as if it were UTC) in evcal_srow /
// evcal_erow, the repeat settings plus every date in repeat_intervals, location / organizer / event type terms, location
// details in the evo_tax_meta option. Dates are relative to today so they are always upcoming.
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
update_option( 'timezone_string', 'America/Chicago' );
$tz  = new DateTimeZone( 'America/Chicago' );
$v   = fn( string $ymd_hm ) => strtotime( $ymd_hm . ' UTC' );
$loc = wp_insert_term( 'Lakeside Taproom', 'event_location' );
$org = wp_insert_term( 'Lakeside Events Team', 'event_organizer' );
$typ = array();
foreach ( array( 'Weekly', 'Music', 'Special' ) as $t ) {
	$r          = wp_insert_term( $t, 'event_type' );
	$typ[ $t ] = is_wp_error( $r ) ? 0 : (int) $r['term_id'];
}
update_option( 'evo_tax_meta', array( 'event_location' => array( (int) $loc['term_id'] => array( 'location_address' => '7701 Lake Ave, Dallas, TX 75209', 'location_lat' => '32.84', 'location_lon' => '-96.80' ) ) ) );
$ev = function ( string $title, array $meta, string $type, string $content = '' ) use ( $loc, $org, $typ ) {
	$id = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_type' => 'ajde_events', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_title' => $title, 'post_content' => $content ?: 'Join us for ' . $title . '.' ) );
	foreach ( $meta as $k => $val ) {
		update_post_meta( $id, $k, $val ); }
	wp_set_object_terms( $id, array( (int) $loc['term_id'] ), 'event_location' );
	wp_set_object_terms( $id, array( (int) $org['term_id'] ), 'event_organizer' );
	wp_set_object_terms( $id, array( $typ[ $type ] ), 'event_type' );
	update_post_meta( $id, '_evo_tz', 'America/Chicago' );
	return $id;
};
// every date of a repeat, as EventON saves them: [[start, end], …] in its virtual time
$dates = function ( string $first, string $step, int $n, string $h1, string $h2 ) use ( $v, $tz ) {
	$d   = new DateTimeImmutable( $first, $tz );
	$out = array();
	for ( $i = 0; $i < $n; $i++ ) {
		$day   = $d->modify( "+$i $step" )->format( 'Y-m-d' );
		$out[] = array( $v( "$day $h1" ), $v( "$day $h2" ) );
	}
	return $out;
};
$first_of = function ( string $dow, int $months_ahead ) use ( $tz ) {
	return ( new DateTimeImmutable( "first $dow of +$months_ahead month", $tz ) )->format( 'Y-m-d' );
};
$tue    = ( new DateTimeImmutable( 'next tuesday', $tz ) )->format( 'Y-m-d' );
$fri    = ( new DateTimeImmutable( 'next friday', $tz ) )->format( 'Y-m-d' );
$trivia = $dates( $tue, 'week', 6, '19:00', '21:00' );
$music  = $dates( $fri, 'week', 6, '20:00', '22:30' );
$ev( 'Tuesday Trivia', array( 'evcal_srow' => $trivia[0][0], 'evcal_erow' => $trivia[0][1], 'evcal_repeat' => 'yes', 'evcal_rep_freq' => 'weekly', 'evcal_rep_gap' => 1, 'evp_repeat_rb_wk' => 'sing', 'evcal_rep_num' => 6, 'repeat_intervals' => $trivia, 'evcal_event_color' => '2d7ff9' ), 'Weekly' );
$ev( 'Live Music Fridays', array( 'evcal_srow' => $music[0][0], 'evcal_erow' => $music[0][1], 'evcal_repeat' => 'yes', 'evcal_rep_freq' => 'weekly', 'evcal_rep_gap' => 1, 'evp_repeat_rb_wk' => 'sing', 'evcal_rep_num' => 6, 'repeat_intervals' => $music, 'evcal_event_color' => 'e0457b' ), 'Music' );
$runs = array();
for ( $m = 0; $m < 3; $m++ ) {
	$d      = $first_of( 'saturday', $m + ( $first_of( 'saturday', 0 ) < gmdate( 'Y-m-d' ) ? 1 : 0 ) );
	$runs[] = array( $v( "$d 09:00" ), $v( "$d 10:30" ) );
}
$ev( 'First Saturday Run Club', array( 'evcal_srow' => $runs[0][0], 'evcal_erow' => $runs[0][1], 'evcal_repeat' => 'yes', 'evcal_rep_freq' => 'monthly', 'evcal_rep_gap' => 1, 'evp_repeat_rb' => 'dow', 'evo_rep_WK' => array( '6' ), 'evo_repeat_wom' => array( '1' ), 'repeat_intervals' => $runs ), 'Weekly' );
$rel = ( new DateTimeImmutable( '+10 days', $tz ) )->format( 'Y-m-d' );
$ev( 'Winter Stout Release', array( 'evcal_srow' => $v( "$rel 16:00" ), 'evcal_erow' => $v( "$rel 22:00" ), 'evcal_subtitle' => 'Tapping at 4', 'evcal_exlink' => 'https://example.com/stout' ), 'Special' );
$mk = ( new DateTimeImmutable( '+17 days', $tz ) )->format( 'Y-m-d' );
$ev( 'Holiday Makers Market', array( 'evcal_srow' => $v( "$mk 00:00" ), 'evcal_erow' => $v( "$mk 23:59" ), 'evcal_allday' => 'yes' ), 'Special' );
// the page visitors use today: EventON's shortcodes, which Beacon renders once EventON is switched off
wp_insert_post( array( 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_title' => 'What\'s On', 'post_name' => 'whats-on', 'post_content' => "<!-- wp:shortcode -->[add_eventon_list number_of_months=\"2\"]<!-- /wp:shortcode -->" ) );
echo "seeded EventON\n";
